items.title: Resurf – realistic, reproducible test framework for AI browser agents
items.raw_excerpt:
Systematic testing of browser agents today is not easy: testing on real websites is flaky, rate-limited and potentially expensive (e.g. using proxies or bypassing Captcha), while static-HTML benchmarks lack state and dynamic behavior. Resurf gives your browser agent a realistic, stateful, instrumented framework — built on synthetic websites with failure-mode injection: - Realistic, dynamic, interactive environment
- Deterministic & reproducible
- Failure-mode injection (latency, payment errors, 5xx)
- Auditable success eval (DB state, not LLM judge)
- No dependency on live websites
- Browser Use and Stagehand supported out of the box

items.title: 重新思考 AI TCO：为何每 Token 成本才是唯一重要的指标
items.raw_excerpt: 传统数据中心过去主要用于数据的存储、检索与处理。但在生成式 AI 与代理式 AI 时代，这些设施已演变为 AI Token 工厂。随着 AI 推理成为其核心工作负载，它们的主要产出已转变为以 Token 形式制造的智能。

title_i18n.zh: 重新思考 AI TCO：为何每 Token 成本才是唯一重要的指标
title_i18n.en: Rethinking AI TCO: Why Cost Per Token Is the Only Metric That Matters
title_i18n.es: Repensando el TCO de la IA: por qué el coste por token es la única métrica que importa

excerpt_i18n.zh: 传统数据中心过去主要用于数据的存储、检索与处理。但在生成式 AI 与代理式 AI 时代，这些设施已演变为 AI Token 工厂。随着 AI 推理成为其核心工作负载，它们的主要产出已转变为以 Token 形式制造的智能。
excerpt_i18n.en: Traditional data centers were primarily used for data storage, retrieval, and processing. However, in the era of generative AI and agentic AI, these facilities have evolved into AI token factories. As AI inference becomes their core workload, their primary output has shifted to intelligence manufactured in the form of tokens.
excerpt_i18n.es: Los centros de datos tradicionales se utilizaban principalmente para el almacenamiento, la recuperación y el procesamiento de datos. Sin embargo, en la era de la IA generativa y la IA basada en agentes, estas instalaciones han evolucionado hasta convertirse en fábricas de tokens de IA. A medida que la inferencia de IA se convierte en su carga de trabajo principal, su producción principal se ha transformado en inteligencia fabricada en forma de tokens.
